Michael OyaroAdvocate · Managing Partner
Profile

Commercially aware counsel with a strategic approach to disputes.

Michael Oyaro is publicly listed as Managing Partner of Michael Oyaro & Company Advocates. His professional profile reflects a Nairobi-based practice serving individuals, companies and institutions across commercial, regulatory and contentious matters.

The firm’s work includes corporate and commercial law, litigation, arbitration and mediation, employment, property, finance, governance audits and other specialist advisory areas.
